blocks.text: Roku Voice Remote will level up your entertainment experience, whether you’re upgrading or replacing another remote. The simple-to-use Roku voice remote puts streaming, TV, movies, gaming, and more all in the palm of your hand. Easily search for entertainment, launch streaming channels, and control your TV—including volume, mute, and closed captions—all with your voice. If you’d rather use physical buttons, volume, mute, and power are conveniently located to make controlling your TV a breeze. For even quicker access to your favorite entertainment, there are four pre-set channel shortcut buttons that launch with a tap and put you right in the action. Plus, setting up Roku voice remote is as simple as could be—just turn on your Roku device, pull the battery tab on the back of the remote, and the remote should pair automatically. Roku voice remote will work with most recent Roku players, all Roku TV™ models, and Roku audio products.
